# Yaps plugins for Codex

> Twelve focused Codex plugins use one Yaps desktop installation for persistent local Markdown memory, live dictation, media transcription, meeting transcription, subtitle generation, video-to-audio conversion, audio cleanup, text-to-speech, finished auto-captioned videos, dead-space video clipping, local image background removal, and on-device translation.

## Canonical facts

- Marketplace: Yaps
- Repository: https://github.com/richawo/yaps-codex-plugin
- Website: https://www.yaps.ai/
- Download: https://yaps.ai/download
- Publisher: Yaps AI
- License for plugin packages: MIT
- Category: Productivity
- Yaps desktop platforms: macOS and Windows
- Shared dependency: the separately installed Yaps desktop application
- Authentication: handled only inside Yaps; plugins never receive credentials or tokens
- Local integration: Yaps ships `yaps_mcp` for memory and `yaps_cli` for local automation

## Plugins

- Yaps Memory: persistent cross-chat memory, remembered facts, personal knowledge, local Markdown search, citations, and permission-controlled updates.
- Yaps Dictation: system-wide voice typing setup, readiness checks, troubleshooting, and recent-dictation recovery.
- Yaps Transcription: existing audio or video to a plain-text transcript.
- Yaps Meeting Transcription: timed meeting transcripts with editable speaker labels.
- Yaps Subtitle Generator: existing audio or video to subtitles, closed captions, and a timestamped `.srt` file.
- Yaps Video to Audio: video to MP3, WAV, or M4A audio extraction.
- Yaps Audio Cleaner: local noise, hiss, and static removal for speech recordings.
- Yaps Text to Speech: text or text files to local WAV or PCM speech.
- Yaps Video Captions: editable word-timed captions, 14 visual templates, and burned-in MP4 export for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, interviews, and tutorials.
- Yaps Video Clipping: local dead-air and long-pause removal with reviewable cut plans, pacing presets, and non-destructive MP4 export.
- Yaps Background Remover: local JPG, PNG, WebP, or BMP subject cutouts with transparent PNG or solid-colour export.
- Accurate Translation: local text, Markdown, plain-text document, and SRT translation without metered cloud translation/API tokens.

## Important boundaries

- Installing a plugin does not create, host, or upload a vault.
- Yaps Memory is not native ChatGPT/model memory and does not modify model weights.
- Yaps Dictation does not intercept Codex's built-in microphone button; Yaps uses its own configurable global shortcut.
- File transcription, subtitle generation, and video-to-audio conversion use the installed Yaps engine and do not silently switch to a hosted provider.
- Text-to-speech preserves the supplied script unless rewriting was explicitly requested.
- Auto Captions creates a new video, preserves the source, and uses the Yaps app for visual previews and detailed styling.
- Video Clipping removes pauses rather than semantic highlights, preserves the source, and never silently overwrites an existing export.
- Background Remover processes one selected still image locally, preserves the source, and does not silently switch to a hosted image service.
- Accurate Translation runs its translation model locally, preserves the source and file structure, and does not silently switch to a hosted translation service.
- The repository contains no user data, credentials, telemetry client, private Yaps application source, or speech-model binaries.
- Plugins automatically locate and validate the CLI packaged inside a standard Yaps installation. No separate CLI installation, PATH edit, token copy, or plugin-specific Connect button is required.
- The same signed-in Yaps account is reused automatically. An active free trial or Yaps Pro grants access; signed-out, expired, and mobile-only states receive specific guidance without exposing credentials.
- Safe automatic account handoff requires Yaps 2.3.124 or newer. The Setapp edition is not yet supported by plugin automation because it uses a separate activation store.

## Installation

1. Download Yaps desktop: https://yaps.ai/download
2. Add the marketplace: `codex plugin marketplace add richawo/yaps-codex-plugin`
3. Install the desired `yaps-*@yaps` plugins.
4. Sign in to Yaps and activate the free trial shown by Yaps or Yaps Pro.
5. Start a new Codex task; the plugin locates the packaged CLI automatically. For Memory writes, enable the existing permission under Yaps Agent Access only when you want the agent to edit notes.
